examined_formations.title: CHINA_QINGDAO_SELF_SERVICE_SHRIMP_HOTPOT_FRANCHISE_DIRECT_OPERATOR_FAILURE_WITH_REALIZED_SHUTDOWN_BUT_UNCLOSED_RESIDUALS
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A September 2026 Bandao report identifies a Shanxi small-restaurant operator who opened one Jianglaolao self-service shrimp-hotpot franchise store in Qingdao Chengyang Gaoxinqu Lanxiucheng after a franchise/service relationship was arranged.

The operator reports more than RMB1.5 million total entry spending, including a franchise fee above RMB100,000 and renovation above RMB400,000; the counterparty confirms a one-year guidance-service contract.
The same store reported RMB600,000-700,000 first-month sales but more than RMB200,000 first-month loss after raw materials, rent and labor; second-month loss was RMB30,000-40,000.
After roughly four months the same operator could no longer pay wages or rent and closed the store.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The operator obtained a branded restaurant position, a mall lease footprint, supplied fit-out/equipment and a one-year service relationship rather than merely buying commodity equipment.
Customer payments were real and large enough to prove demand, but the brand/supply/point position did not convert gross turnover into normalized positive cashflow.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: After the first-month loss the operator changed sourcing for some ingredients and raised prices, then borrowed from relatives and friends to continue trading.
The store used online influencer traffic at opening and continued online promotion, showing acquisition was an active operating input rather than passive machine demand.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: Entry cost, received sales, major operating-cost categories, monthly losses and shutdown all bind to the same reported store/operator, making this a substantially tighter packet than a franchise calculator.
The complete direct-cost ledger is still not itemized, exact owner hours/replacement cost are not published, and the operator's claimed total loss exceeds the independently closed line items.

Residual value is unsettled: the operator says a RMB50,000-60,000 final inventory return was not reimbursed; the counterparty says some franchise/service fee may be refundable and disputes the claimed total loss.
The underlying restaurant remains labor-, sourcing-, promotion- and site-intensive, so the packet does not establish founder-light machine-delegatable delivery.
economic_signal: Same-operator reported entry spend exceeds RMB1.5 million.
Same-store first-month sales were RMB600,000-700,000 with reported loss above RMB200,000 after raw material, rent and labor; second-month loss was RMB30,000-40,000.
The store shut after about four months when wages and rent could no longer be paid.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Brand/service terms, mall point access, supply terms and customer-acquisition channels remain outside the operator's exclusive reusable control.
The counterparty confirms a one-year service contract but disputes liability, showing the control relationship is contractual and contested rather than an operator-owned transferable rail.
Equivalent restaurant operators can contract for comparable branded or unbranded food-service positions; no compounding routing/control asset is evidenced.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_GUANGZHOU_PAID_STUDY_ROOM_DIRECT_OPERATOR_WITH_MACHINE_LIGHT_SERVICE_BUT_ESTIMATED_NOT_REALIZED_P_AND_L
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A July 2026 Guangzhou Daily report interviews Mr Zhang, who this year rented a 110-square-meter second-floor commercial space and converted it into a paid study room with more than 40 seats.
The same operator's monthly rent is RMB5,700 and the room sells seat time plus lockers, printing, tea/drinks and custodial add-on services.
The operator says returns have been satisfactory but management requires more time and attention than expected.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The service can use platform/miniprogram booking and standardized furnishings/air/booking systems, so basic access and payment are relatively machine-light.
The scarce input is primarily suitable leased property and local demand rather than proprietary technology or exclusive distribution.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The operator mixes student and adult demand across after-school, evening and weekend periods and adds storage, printing and beverage services.
The article describes ongoing customer service, onsite management, environment planning and hardware issue handling as key drivers of retention.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The RMB5,700 monthly rent and 40-plus-seat footprint are bound to Mr Zhang's actual room.
The 15%-22% seat-only annualized return and 25%-32% return with add-ons are explicitly described as preliminary calculations, not a realized full-period P&L with received receipts.
The article's separate RMB70,000-80,000 fit-out example belongs to a different 82-square-meter operator and is not stitched into Mr Zhang's economics.
No exact initial capex for Mr Zhang, complete operating-cost ledger, owner hours/replacement cost, transferable lease rights or realized exit value is published.
economic_signal: Same-operator monthly rent is RMB5,700 for a 110-square-meter location with more than 40 seats.
Participant/article preliminary return estimates are 15%-22% annualized for seat rental and 25%-32% with add-ons, but realized revenue and full costs are not disclosed.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The article reports highly standardized business logic, furniture, ventilation and booking systems across surveyed study rooms.
Local property availability, service responsiveness and onsite operations differentiate outcomes; libraries, community learning centers and cafes are active substitutes.
No exclusive customer rail, proprietary software right or transferable noncommodity control surface is evidenced.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_CHENGDU_INDEPENDENT_LIQUOR_SHOP_DIRECT_OPERATOR_REVENUE_COLLAPSE_WHEN_PERSONAL_AUDIENCE_IS_ABSENT
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A September 2026 Daily Economic News field report visits Maodaxiong liquor shop on Chengdu Fangcao Street and interviews its owner, a short-video blogger who also creates signature mixed drinks.
The owner says store business depends heavily on her personal followers and drops materially when she is not present.
During a month when the owner was occupied elsewhere, store revenue was below RMB10,000 while monthly rent was nearly RMB20,000.
The store has operated for more than a year, and the owner says visible busyness translates into limited profit.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The shop has a physical point, product assortment and local social experience, but its strongest acquisition asset is the owner's pre-existing personal audience and presence.
That audience can pull demand, but it is person-bound rather than an independently transferable machine-operated control surface.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The owner uses short-video influence and distinctive cocktails to generate traffic.
The broader field report shows liquor-shop operators using live streaming, community repeat purchase and hands-on service to compensate for weak walk-in demand.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The same-store low-revenue month and rent are directly bound to the independent owner and show an unusually clear founder-absence counterfactual.
Initial control cost, normal-month realized receipts, complete product/labor/platform costs, owner hours and exit value are not disclosed.
The article separately reports more than RMB500,000 aggregate entry investment across two Waimai franchise stores; that multi-store group figure is not imported into this single independent shop.
The strongest demand advantage is the owner's personal audience, which fails founder independence even if it is commercially real.
economic_signal: A same-store month with the owner occupied elsewhere produced less than RMB10,000 revenue against nearly RMB20,000 monthly rent.
The operator says the store has been open more than a year but earns only limited profit despite appearing busy.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The decisive observed acquisition surface is a personal short-video following plus local community repeat purchase, not a transferable store-owned channel.
Product supply and retail format are broadly substitutable; the report describes many chain and independent entrants competing in the same local category.
A replacement operator would not inherit the owner's personal audience merely by controlling the physical shop.
